action_items: REVIEW REQUEST DATA MISMATCH (not a bug): Review claims 'N10036 has 20/20 kopitiam' but actual DB has kopitiam qty_diterima=20 vs PO qty=50 (kurang kirim=30). If main agent expected N10036 PO to be komplit, either seed additional BM for kopitiam (30 more) OR reduce PO kopitiam qty to 20.

rca of the issue: The single pytest failure (TestBMKomplitData.test_n10036_qty_diterima_full) is due to a mismatch between the review request statement ('20/20 kopitiam') and actual DB data (20/50 kopitiam). The BM UI code correctly gates 'KOMPLIT PO' on totalDiterima>=totalPO across all PO items, so it will only appear when ALL items reach their PO qty — which N10036 currently does not. Fix path: either add BM entry for 30 more kopitiam units, or lower kopitiam PO qty from 50 to 20.
